sources.entry: CursorSense - Mouse & trackpad driver that lets you tweak the acceleration curve and more.

summary.name: CursorSense
summary.one_liner: A macOS app that adjusts mouse cursor acceleration, sensitivity and tracking speed, and can snap the cursor to buttons such as OK or Cancel.
keywords: auto move cursor to ok button
use_cases: Tune mouse acceleration and sensitivity beyond System Settings
Make a Mac cursor feel like Windows cursor movement
Set flatter cursor movement for drawing
Adjust high-DPI gaming mouse cursor speed on macOS
Automatically move the cursor to OK or Cancel buttons
Save separate mouse settings for each device
summary.what_it_does: CursorSense adjusts both mouse sensitivity (cursor distance per inch of mouse movement) and tracking speed (acceleration), which macOS System Settings does not expose separately. Settings can be configured per mouse, so switching devices does not require re-tuning. It can automatically move the cursor to a specified destination such as an OK or Cancel button, optionally returning to the original position afterward, with destinations set per application. A Recommended Settings view shows popular user settings for reference. The page notes that the built-in trackpad, Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad do not support sensitivity changes.
notable: Separates sensitivity from acceleration, which System Settings combines
Snaps cursor to specified buttons per application
Recommended Settings ranking of popular user configurations
caveats: Licence fee is US$9.99; a 20-day trial is available without limitations.
Built-in trackpad, Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad do not support sensitivity changes.
Major upgrades (e.g. 2.0 to 3.0) are charged; minor upgrades are free.
